title: The Latest Crier for Mar 07, 2026
items:
ZY Sweets For Your Sweetie Fundraiser

Buy some Sweets for your Sweetie from Zeta Upsilon Feb 9-12, from 5-8 pm in the Maytag Atrium for only $3! You can choose between chocolate candies, fruit-flavored candies, or a mix to show how well you know your Sweetie!

Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Computer Science Club First Meeting Thursday March 12th

We are here to talk all things tech! We will be doing discussions, competitions, and activities related to the field of Computer Science. We are open to anyone; you DON'T have to be a Computer Science major! At our first meeting, we will be: 
- Talking about officer positions 

-Brainstorming ideas for this semester 

-Socializing over free COOKIES!! 

Our first meeting will be in VSC 243 on Thursday, March 12th, 8-9pm! Hope to see you there! If you have any questions, please email geistkempers1@central.edu

March Madness: a new bracket challenge for you!

Do you fill out an NCAA March Madness bracket every year, hoping to achieve the perfect bracket...and then end up inevitably disappointed that your friends chose teams better than you? Well, come to a presentation by Prof. G. (Dr. Goodman) on Tuesday, March 10 at 11am in VSC 180 to hear about the current state of March Madness bracket prediction ideas, along with a new type of March Madness pool you will be introduced to and can potentially take part in. There might even be treats!

CAB Application- Extended Deadline

There is still time to join CAB for the Fall 2026 semester! Be a part of the planning of campus events to build community across campus! 
Apply Here ! Deadline to apply is by the end of the day on Sunday, March 8. 

Questions? Contact Allyson Mann at manna@central.edu

Looking for a summer job?

THURSDAY, MARCH 12 | 10AM-2PM | MAYTAG STUDENT CENTER ATRIUM Wesley Woods Iowa will be on campus to visit with students about positions available to include: Cabin Shepherds - Barn Staff - Kitchen Staff - Leadership Staff 
Stop by Maytag Student Center to visit with recruiter Micah Spurlock.She can be contacted at: micah.spurlock@wesleywoodsiowa.org 

Or visit their website: Wesley Woods Iowa

2026-2027 Green Pod Applications Open Now!

Are you interested in the three pillars of sustainability (social, economic, environmental)? Do you have a group of friends who love to volunteer? Want to pick your pod before housing sign up even starts? Apply to live in a green pod! Click here to learn more. Applications are due on Friday, March 13th at 4 pm. Questions? Contact lunsfords@central.edu.

Class of 2026 Grad Finale Event

Class of 2026 Grad Finale Important Announcement Grad Finale will take place from 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. Tuesday, March 10, in the Moore/Weller Rooms of Maytag Student Center. While you're there: 
Pick up your free cap and gown. 

Receive your first alumni gift. 

Grab your friends for a picture in the selfie booth. 

Contribute to the Senior Class Gift. 

Let the college know what your next adventure will be

Inclusive Housing Applications Due Soon!

Inclusive Housing in Nanes (near the library) is open to students who are allies, advocates, and/or exploring their identities. Residents must be active members of a student organization supporting an underrepresented group, submit a reflection each semester, and attend and reflect on one identity-focused campus event per semester. Applications are due Friday, March 13 at 4 pm. Click here to learn more and apply!

Language Placement Test

Students who need to take a Language Placement Test for Spanish or German can stop by the Vermeer Science Center (VSC), Room #241 from 11:00am-12:00pm on Tuesday, March 10th. Use the following link to add your name and select a time to confirm your attendance. Contact Dr. Ally Krogstad ( krogstada@central.edu ) or Prof. Oscar Reynaga ( reynagao@central.edu ) if you have any questions.

Learn About Scotland! March 10

Want to study abroad in Scotland? Shannon from University of Scotland will be here March 10. 
We will be in Maytag to talk from 11-1 pm. Cashen Thompson just returned from Scotland and Katelyn De Boer is there right now. Talk with them about what their semester looked like!

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 3/8/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

See what’s new at Pella Cinemas | Central Student Free Movie Night | Sunday, March 8

Check out the remodeled space, new seating options, and new concession offerings! Central students can enjoy a free movie for the 5:30, 5:45, or 6:00pm shows on Sunday, March 8th! Show your Central ID at the theater concessions to get your free movie ticket! NOTE: tickets and seating options are subject to availability!
